style: Style: flat cartoon children's-book illustration exactly like the drawing style of image 0: thick dark outlines, soft warm colours, big friendly eyes, simple clean shapes, bright daylight. Square picture. Egyptian setting. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no writing anywhere in the picture.
